'''Staarn''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Bothan/Legends|Bothan]] [[Crime lord/Legends|crime lord]] who operated in the [[High City of Refuge]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Kidron/Legends|Kidron]] during the reign of the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]].
